note: Plain-English titles and summaries drafted by an LLM (Claude) from each trial's public ClinicalTrials.gov record on 2026-11-14 as the spec's offline-LLM step. NOT reviewed by a clinician or by the trial sponsors. No efficacy claims intended. Regenerate with `python -m services.api.trials.ingest_ctgov --llm` or edit by hand.

NCT05404061.lay_title: Why weight-loss surgery works less well for some
NCT05404061.lay_summary: This study looks at gut hormones in people who have had, or are waiting for, weight-loss surgery. Taking part involves visits to a London research unit, where hormones are given through a small needle under the skin and measurements are taken.

NCT07784270.lay_title: A weekly injection for weight in type 2 diabetes
NCT07784270.lay_summary: This study tests a new medicine, lenbelintide, against a dummy injection in adults with type 2 diabetes who are overweight. It measures change in body weight over about 68 weeks. Taking part involves regular clinic visits. UK sites include Chippenham, Corby, Hull and Northwood.

NCT07065383.lay_title: Semaglutide, exercise and fat in the heart
NCT07065383.lay_summary: This study looks at what happens to fat inside the heart and leg muscles when people with type 2 diabetes take semaglutide, with or without a supervised exercise programme. Taking part involves scans and exercise tests in Aberdeen.

NCT04786262.lay_title: Cell therapy for type 1 diabetes with severe hypos
NCT04786262.lay_summary: This study tests an infusion of insulin-producing cells in adults with type 1 diabetes who have severe low blood sugars without warning signs. It checks safety and how well it works. Sites include London, Edinburgh, Oxford and Newcastle.

NCT07668336.lay_title: A daily tablet for young people with type 2 diabetes
NCT07668336.lay_summary: This study compares a tablet called orforglipron with a weekly injection, dulaglutide, in young people aged 10 to 17 with type 2 diabetes. Taking part lasts about 61 weeks, with regular visits. Sites include London, Liverpool and Hull.

NCT06572345.lay_title: Low-energy diet for teenagers with type 2 diabetes
NCT06572345.lay_summary: This study tests whether a short-term low-energy diet is practical for teenagers aged 12 to 17 with obesity and type 2 diabetes. Some young people and parents are also interviewed about their experience. The study is run in Nottingham.

NCT06803771.lay_title: A blood test for pancreas health after diabetes diagnosis
NCT06803771.lay_summary: This study checks whether a new blood test can spot pancreatic cancer early in people aged 50 to 84 recently diagnosed with type 2 diabetes or raised blood sugar. Taking part means three visits over 12 months, a blood sample and a short questionnaire each time.

NCT07743450.lay_title: A daily weight-management tablet in type 2 diabetes
NCT07743450.lay_summary: This study compares three doses of a once-daily tablet, ASC30, with a dummy tablet in adults with type 2 diabetes who are overweight. It looks at long-term effects and safety. UK sites include London, Cardiff, Glasgow and Manchester.

NCT05142189.lay_title: An early-stage lung cancer treatment study
NCT05142189.lay_summary: This is a first-in-human study of BNT116, alone or with other cancer medicines, in adults with advanced non-small cell lung cancer. It mainly checks safety and dose. Sites include London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Liverpool and Newcastle.

NCT01945840.lay_title: Gut hormones after gastric bypass surgery
NCT01945840.lay_summary: This study looks at whether changes in gut hormones explain some effects seen after gastric bypass surgery. Depending on the group, taking part can involve surgery already planned, a very low calorie diet, or hormone infusions, with tests at a London research unit.

NCT06782568.lay_title: Ultrasound checks of insulin injection sites
NCT06782568.lay_summary: Lumps of fatty tissue can form where insulin is injected. This study tests whether an ultrasound scan in the diabetes clinic helps people who use insulin find and avoid them. It takes place in London.

NCT07051005.lay_title: An online self-compassion course for diabetes
NCT07051005.lay_summary: This study tests whether a four-week online programme based on compassion training is practical and acceptable for adults with type 1 or type 2 diabetes. It aims at diabetes distress and self-criticism. It is run online from London and Bangor.

NCT07797335.lay_title: A weekly injection compared with insulin glargine
NCT07797335.lay_summary: This study compares a new weekly injection, zenagamtide, with insulin glargine in people aged 45 and over with type 2 diabetes and a higher risk of heart problems, who already take one to three diabetes medicines. UK sites include Bristol, Coventry, Hull and Swansea.

NCT06579404.lay_summary: This study tests a fully closed-loop system, where a sensor and pump adjust insulin automatically, in adults with type 2 diabetes who use insulin. It is compared with usual insulin injections plus a glucose sensor. Sites include Cambridge, London, Manchester and Leicester.

NCT06844539.lay_title: Short intensive insulin for recent type 2 diabetes
NCT06844539.lay_summary: This study asks whether up to 12 weeks of automated insulin delivery, plus diet and lifestyle education, can put recently diagnosed type 2 diabetes into remission. It is compared with standard care. The study is run in Cambridge.

NCT07064473.lay_title: Two tablets for diabetes, blood pressure and heart disease
NCT07064473.lay_summary: This study is for adults with type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure and heart or blood vessel disease, without heart failure. It compares a new tablet, vicadrostat, taken with empagliflozin, against a dummy tablet with empagliflozin. There are many UK sites.

NCT07684144.lay_title: Long-term follow-on study of a weight injection
NCT07684144.lay_summary: This is an extension study of maridebart cafraglutide for people with obesity and type 2 diabetes who took part in an earlier linked trial. It looks at long-term effects and safety. The UK site is in Birmingham.

NCT07662135.lay_title: A new tablet for diabetes with reduced kidney function
NCT07662135.lay_summary: This study compares a tablet called elecoglipron with a dummy tablet in adults with type 2 diabetes and reduced kidney function who also take dapagliflozin. UK sites include Glasgow, Hull, Blackpool and Penzance.

NCT07321886.lay_title: A weight injection for people without type 2 diabetes
NCT07321886.lay_summary: This study tests eloralintide against a dummy injection in adults with obesity or overweight who do not have type 2 diabetes. The main part lasts about 75 weeks. UK sites include Manchester, Blackpool, Lancaster and Peterborough.

NCT07285811.lay_title: Whey protein before meals for older adults
NCT07285811.lay_summary: This study looks at whether a whey protein drink before meals changes blood sugar levels in people aged 70 to 90 with type 2 diabetes. Blood sugar is tracked over seven days of normal daily life. It is run in Birmingham.

NCT06739135.lay_title: Driving training for people with diabetic nerve damage
NCT06739135.lay_summary: This study tests whether visual feedback training improves use of the accelerator pedal in drivers with diabetes and nerve damage in the feet. Taking part involves about six sessions, a month apart, in Manchester.

NCT07351045.lay_title: A weight-management injection without type 2 diabetes
NCT07351045.lay_summary: This study compares several doses of enicepatide with a dummy injection in adults with obesity or overweight and a weight-related health problem, who do not have type 2 diabetes. UK sites include London, Birmingham, Glasgow and Leicester.

NCT07667803.lay_title: A weight-management tablet, with or without diabetes
NCT07667803.lay_summary: This programme of two studies compares a tablet, elecoglipron, with a dummy tablet alongside diet and exercise, in adults with obesity or overweight. One study is for people with type 2 diabetes and one for people without. There are many UK sites.

NCT06435156.lay_title: A tablet for heart failure in type 1 diabetes
NCT06435156.lay_summary: This study tests whether a tablet called sotagliflozin changes quality of life in adults with type 1 diabetes and heart failure symptoms, compared with a dummy tablet. UK sites include London, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Manchester and Sheffield.

NCT07364045.lay_title: Diet replacement and pancreas fat in type 2 diabetes
NCT07364045.lay_summary: This study looks at how fat in the pancreas relates to type 2 diabetes and what happens during weight loss. Taking part involves a total diet replacement programme and scans. It is for people aged 45 to 79 and is run in Edinburgh.

NCT07662109.lay_title: Two diabetes tablets together or alone
NCT07662109.lay_summary: This study compares elecoglipron and dapagliflozin taken together with each tablet taken alone, in adults whose type 2 diabetes is not well controlled by lifestyle or current medicines. UK sites include Dundee, Rotherham, Blackburn and Witney.

NCT06471634.lay_title: Better sleep and less sitting with type 2 diabetes
NCT06471634.lay_summary: This study tests whether a sleep therapy programme and support to sit less are practical for adults with type 2 diabetes who have sleep problems. Sleep and activity are measured with wearable monitors. It is run in Leicester.

NCT07422532.lay_title: An automated insulin pump for people on dialysis
NCT07422532.lay_summary: This study tests an automated insulin pump system, Omnipod 5, against insulin injections in adults with type 2 diabetes who have haemodialysis. Sites are in London, Manchester and Derby.

NCT07776509.lay_title: Adding a new weight injection to current treatment
NCT07776509.lay_summary: This study tests lenbelintide against a dummy injection in adults with obesity or overweight who already take a GLP-1 type medicine, with or without type 2 diabetes. It lasts about 68 weeks. UK sites include Hull, Chippenham, Rotherham and Airdrie.

NCT06451757.lay_title: A tablet for fatigue in mitochondrial disease
NCT06451757.lay_summary: This study compares a medicine called sonlicromanol with a dummy tablet in adults with primary mitochondrial disease. It looks at tiredness, balance and muscle strength. The UK site is in London.

NCT07351058.lay_title: A weight-management injection in type 2 diabetes
NCT07351058.lay_summary: This study compares several doses of enicepatide with a dummy injection for weight management in adults with type 2 diabetes who have obesity or overweight. UK sites include Bristol, Hull, Aberdeen, Plymouth and Hounslow.

NCT07662213.lay_title: A new diabetes tablet compared with semaglutide tablets
NCT07662213.lay_summary: This study compares elecoglipron with semaglutide tablets in adults with type 2 diabetes and a higher risk of heart problems, whose blood sugar is not well controlled. UK sites include Bristol, Edinburgh, Aberdeen, Hounslow and Poole.

NCT02817360.lay_title: Heart-protecting medicines guided by a blood test
NCT02817360.lay_summary: This study is for people with type 2 diabetes and no known heart disease whose blood test suggests extra strain on the heart. It compares high doses of common blood-pressure medicines with usual care. UK sites include Glasgow, Dundee, Manchester and Sheffield.

NCT06897475.lay_title: An add-on for people already on semaglutide or tirzepatide
NCT06897475.lay_summary: This study tests a new medicine, LY3457263, against a dummy treatment in adults with type 2 diabetes whose HbA1c is above target on a stable dose of semaglutide or tirzepatide. It lasts about nine months. There are several UK sites.

NCT07247084.lay_title: Tirzepatide in everyday care for people without diabetes
NCT07247084.lay_summary: This study compares tirzepatide with usual care in adults with obesity and a weight-related health problem who do not have diabetes. It follows people for about five years. You must be registered at a taking-part GP practice, mostly in Greater Manchester.

NCT07881432.lay_title: A combined weight injection, opening soon
NCT07881432.lay_summary: This study compares a combined injection of eloralintide and tirzepatide with each medicine alone and with a dummy injection, in adults with obesity who do not have type 2 diabetes. It lasts about two years. UK sites include London, Blackpool and Penzance.

NCT07565935.lay_title: Interval exercise after the NHS remission diet programme
NCT07565935.lay_summary: This study looks at adding high-intensity interval exercise for people with type 2 diabetes who have followed the NHS Path to Remission diet programme. Taking part involves supervised exercise sessions and tests in Derby. It is not open yet.

NCT07931599.lay_title: Lower-dose weekly injection compared with semaglutide
NCT07931599.lay_summary: This study compares lower doses of a new weekly injection, zenagamtide, with semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes who take metformin, an SGLT2 tablet, or both. Treatment is decided by chance. UK sites include London, Swansea, Rotherham and Truro. Not open yet.

NCT06240403.lay_title: Low-dose digoxin in heart failure with diabetes
NCT06240403.lay_summary: This study looks at the effect of a low dose of digoxin on fat tissue in people who have both heart failure and type 2 diabetes. It is run in Leeds and is not open yet.

NCT07931573.lay_title: Higher-dose weekly injection compared with semaglutide
NCT07931573.lay_summary: This study compares higher doses of a new weekly injection, zenagamtide, with semaglutide in adults with type 2 diabetes who take metformin, an SGLT2 tablet, or both. UK sites include London, Swansea, Rotherham and Truro. It is not open yet.

NCT07560800.lay_title: Beetroot juice and exercise in type 2 diabetes
NCT07560800.lay_summary: This study looks at whether one drink of beetroot juice changes how the heart and blood pressure respond to exercise in adults aged 40 to 65 with type 2 diabetes. It is run in Oxford and is not open yet.
